description:
"Jinah" suffers from insomnia and barely falls asleep ever night by listening to video by the ASMR Youtuber NA. She doesn't solely listen to her for innocent purposes as she has a habit of having to masturbate while listening to her 19+ sub account ASMR to fall asleep. Ironically, "NA" has the same voice, speech pattern, and even mole on her lip as her high school classmate "Hyeo Jinah", who was the one who gave her insomnia... One say, several lecturers come to give a lecture on the topic of "mind healing" for employees for a company workshop and among them is NA, the currently hottest Youtuber. The first face of NA was the face of someone I could never forget. It was "Heo Jinah". The evil person, who stole the person I loved in school and left me alone, turns out to be my favorite Youtuber?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
